summary: Add six Kit composition commands: sequences build, subscribers onboard, purchases log, broadcasts compose, email-templates apply, and export.
reason: Kit v4 has no products/commerce API and email_templates is GET-only, so the published CLI already covers the writable endpoint surface. These commands compose existing v4 endpoints into safer high-level workflows with local validation, explicit dry-run plans, exact cursor pagination, and MCP intent entries.
validated_outcome: Focused CLI tests cover sequence immediate-email validation, purchase unit_price and computed totals, and broadcast compose defaults; dry-run smoke tests exercise each new command without network calls.
